reference_role: Project-owned style/material reference only; original interior composition
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide landscape 16:9 game environment plate for Depths, a gritty dark medieval dungeon crawler, seen in first person from the open entrance looking INTO the player's small expedition tent.
Input reference: the supplied project camp terrain image is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only. Create an original tent interior, do not reproduce the exterior clearing.
Composition: grounded eye-level entrance viewpoint, no people or visible player body. Tent flaps just frame the far left/right edges. A simple low wooden COT occupies the LEFT third, its full recognizable bed silhouette visible, worn stuffed mattress, small pillow, patched dull olive wool blanket with irregular folds, feet nearest the entrance. A substantial CLOSED WOODEN STORAGE CHEST with worn black iron bands stands in the near middle, slightly to the right, separate from the cot and easy to select; its lid and latch clearly readable. A rough small TABLE occupies the RIGHT third, with two large pale cream sheets of paper, a quill and a stub of pencil, and a plain pewter mug. The tabletop and blank paper face the viewer sufficiently clearly for optional game-stat UI to be overlaid later. Leave a narrow open walking space between these three distinct functional areas. A simple round stool partly tucks under the table. Only a few personal belongings: muddy boots under the cot, a small patched travel bag near its head, a cloak on a rear peg. Visible modest patched canvas roof, ridge beam and crooked wooden poles, canvas back wall, rope ties and stitched repairs, dirt floor with an old woven mat.
Style: detailed painterly dark-fantasy environment art with strong material shapes and weathered edges, like the project's camp paintings. Restrained, believable, under-resourced military camp. Scuffed uneven wood, oxidized iron, frayed fabric, repairs and asymmetry. Avoid polished showroom perfection or excessive clutter.
Lighting: a SINGLE modest hanging iron lantern above the table casts soft amber light across paper, chest lid, cot and cloth. Cool overcast daylight softly enters from behind the viewer. Comfortable shelter and momentary safety within a harsh world, subdued amber, tobacco brown, charcoal, grey olive. Clearly readable object silhouettes and midtones at phone size; do not crush the interior to black.
Constraints: exactly one cot on the left, one main closed chest near the middle, one table with blank paper on the right. No interface, no frame, no buttons, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no writing on paper, no logo or watermark. No throne, no luxury furniture, no ornate palace room, no bed curtains, no fireplace, no open campfire, no weapons on the papers. High resolution landscape illustration, clean complete edges.
approval: Owner approved 2026-11-21: The tent painting is absolutely perfect. Pinned pixels and follow-up are in art/camp/player-tent-v1/approval.json.
